63:

118: 
119: - **Outcome:** Browser/MCP mutations emit the same DAV changes as Apple mutations.

121: - **Scope:** Base event create/update/delete paths and transactional revisions.

123: - **Out of scope:** Moves, occurrences, imported feeds, sync response.

130: - **Outcome:** Apple receives only changes after its opaque token, including deletions.

140: 
141: - **Outcome:** No supported Happening mutation bypasses DAV sync.
142: - **Depends on:** T11.
143: - **Scope:** Moves, occurrence changes, supported external/imported paths, source-delete/target-create.

150: ## T13 — All-day semantics
151: 
152: - **Outcome:** All-day events round-trip without date shifts or conversion to timed events.

154: - **Scope:** DATE DTSTART/DTEND, exclusive end, timezone-independent mapping.

156: - **Out of scope:** Recurrence and floating timed events.

160: 
161: ## T14 — Recurrence semantics
162: 
163: - **Outcome:** Series and modified/deleted occurrences round-trip as one canonical resource.

165: - **Scope:** Supported RRULE, RECURRENCE-ID, EXDATE, master ETag/mutation mapping.

173: 
174: - **Outcome:** DAV matches Happening permissions and never makes imported content writable.

176: - **Scope:** Owner/editor/viewer/free-busy, revocation, imported resources, path ownership.

178: - **Out of scope:** New roles/sharing UI.
179: - **Acceptance:** Roles pass the access matrix; revocation is immediate; foreign existence is hidden; imported writes fail.
180: - **Verify:** Table-driven service/HTTP authorization tests.
181: - **Handoff:** Supply matrix and denial codes to T18/T19.

183: ## T16 — Safe client-property preservation
184: 
185: - **Outcome:** Apple edits preserve approved client-owned metadata.
186: - **Depends on:** T14.
187: - **Scope:** Allowlisted alarms, categories, URL, transparency, selected X-properties.
188: - **Changes:** Parse, validate, persist, merge, serialize allowlist; reject scheduling/unsupported components.

192: - **Handoff:** Freeze allowlist/examples for docs.

195: 
196: - **Outcome:** Users safely set up, inspect, revoke, and disconnect devices.

198: - **Scope:** Disconnected, one-time secret, connected, attention, revoke-one, disconnect-all states.

200: - **Out of scope:** Configuration profiles and Apple credentials.

202: - **Verify:** Frontend tests and Playwright lifecycle with immediate DAV failure after revoke.
203: - **Handoff:** T18/T19 reuse setup/error language.
204: 
205: ## T18 — Production hardening
206: 
207: - **Outcome:** DAV fails safely under malformed, oversized, brute-force, or insecure traffic.
208: - **Depends on:** T11, T15, T17.
209: - **Scope:** Parser/body/report limits, DAV rate limits, redacted logs, metrics, HTTPS/proxy validation.
210: - **Changes:** Add bounded middleware/parsers, safe telemetry, and fail-closed production transport checks.
211: - **Out of scope:** General observability redesign.
212: - **Acceptance:** Violations fail before writes; auth throttling is independent; logs contain no credentials/bodies; insecure production config fails closed.
213: - **Verify:** Adversarial suite, redaction/rate tests, production-config smoke test.
214: - **Handoff:** Provide operator checklist and sanitized diagnostics.
215: 
216: ## T19 — Apple compatibility, cleanup, and docs
217: 
218: - **Outcome:** Current macOS/iOS Calendar completes connect, sync, CRUD, and revoke.
219: - **Depends on:** T12, T14, T16, T18.
220: - **Scope:** Real-client acceptance, sanitized fixtures, legacy fake-CalDAV/WebCal cleanup, deployment/user docs.
221: - **Changes:** Test Apple clients; encode protocol differences as regressions; remove misleading scaffold while retaining explicit one-off ICS export.
222: - **Out of scope:** Apple credentials, Apple-side calendar creation/deletion, scheduling, tasks/journals, configuration profiles.
223: - **Acceptance:** Both clients connect; initial/incremental sync and supported CRUD work; revoke fails next request; UI/docs match reality.
224: - **Verify:** Signed device checklist, full DAV/frontend/backend suites, deployment smoke test.
225: - **Handoff:** Release only after this passes; record supported OS versions/limits.
226: 
227: ## Gate 4 summary
228: 
229: - 19 packets: 2 complete, 17 awaiting approval.
230: - 14 waves with limited safe parallelism.
231: - Highest-risk packet: T14 recurrence semantics.
232: - Release boundary: T19; earlier packets are integration checkpoints.

(End of file - total 232 lines)

495:     async fn expanded_recurring_events(
496:         &self,
497:         calendar_id: i64,
498:         range: &EventRange,
499:         access: EventAccess,
500:     ) -> Result<Vec<EventProjection>, EventServiceError> {
501:         let series = sqlx::query_as::<_, RecurringSeriesRecord>(
502:             "SELECT id, calendar_id, title, description, location, status,
503:                     timed_start_utc, timed_end_utc, event_timezone,
504:                     created_by_user_id, last_edited_by_user_id, version,
505:                     created_at, updated_at, recurrence_rule
506:              FROM events
507:              WHERE calendar_id = ? AND recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL AND event_kind = 'timed'",
508:         )
509:         .bind(calendar_id)
510:         .fetch_all(&self.pool)
511:         .await?;
512:         let mut expanded = Vec::new();
513:         for series in series {
514:             let exceptions = sqlx::query_as::<_, RecurrenceExceptionRecord>(
515:                 "SELECT recurrence_id, is_deleted, title, description, location, status,
516:                         timed_start_utc, timed_end_utc, event_timezone
517:                  FROM event_recurrence_exceptions WHERE series_id = ?",
518:             )
519:             .bind(series.id)
520:             .fetch_all(&self.pool)
521:             .await?;
522:             let excluded: HashSet<_> = exceptions
523:                 .iter()
524:                 .filter(|exception| exception.is_deleted)
525:                 .filter_map(|exception| Utc.timestamp_opt(exception.recurrence_id, 0).single())
526:                 .collect();
527:             let modified: HashMap<_, _> = exceptions
528:                 .iter()
529:                 .filter(|exception| !exception.is_deleted)
530:                 .filter_map(|exception| {
531:                     Some((
532:                         Utc.timestamp_opt(exception.recurrence_id, 0).single()?,
533:                         ModifiedOccurrence {
534:                             start: Utc.timestamp_opt(exception.timed_start_utc?, 0).single()?,
535:                             end: Utc.timestamp_opt(exception.timed_end_utc?, 0).single()?,
536:                         },
537:                     ))
538:                 })
539:                 .collect();
540:             let timezone: Tz = series
541:                 .event_timezone
542:                 .parse()
543:                 .map_err(|_| EventServiceError::InvalidInput)?;
544:             let starts_at = timezone.from_utc_datetime(
545:                 &Utc.timestamp_opt(series.timed_start_utc, 0)
546:                     .single()
547:                     .ok_or(EventServiceError::InvalidInput)?
548:                     .naive_utc(),
549:             );
550:             let occurrences = expand_occurrences(
551:                 &RecurringEvent {
552:                     starts_at,
553:                     duration: Duration::seconds(series.timed_end_utc - series.timed_start_utc),
554:                     rule: RecurrenceRule::parse(&series.recurrence_rule)
555:                         .map_err(|_| EventServiceError::InvalidInput)?,
556:                 },
557:                 TimeInterval {
558:                     start: Utc
559:                         .timestamp_opt(range.start_utc, 0)
560:                         .single()
561:                         .ok_or(EventServiceError::InvalidInput)?,
562:                     end: Utc
563:                         .timestamp_opt(range.end_utc, 0)
564:                         .single()
565:                         .ok_or(EventServiceError::InvalidInput)?,
566:                 },
567:                 &excluded,
568:                 &modified,
569:                 ExpansionLimits::default(),
570:             )
571:             .map_err(|_| EventServiceError::InvalidInput)?;
572:             for occurrence in occurrences {
573:                 let exception = exceptions.iter().find(|exception| {
574:                     exception.recurrence_id == occurrence.recurrence_id.timestamp()
575:                         && !exception.is_deleted
576:                 });
577:                 expanded.push(project_occurrence(&series, exception, occurrence, access)?);
578:             }
579:         }
580:         Ok(expanded)
581:     }

1322:             .naive_utc(),

555: /// Conditional `PUT` that creates one supported timed, non-recurring event
556: /// through the domain service and persists the DAV resource mapping.
557: ///
558: /// Requires `If-None-Match: *`. Fails with 412 when the resource already
559: /// exists, 409 when the client-supplied UID is already mapped in the
560: /// calendar, and rolls back the event when the mapping cannot be written.
561: async fn handle_put_create_event_resource(
562:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
563:     session: &DavSession,
564:     principal_id: &str,
565:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
566:     resource_name: &str,
567:     request: Request,
568: ) -> Response {
569:     let if_none_match = request
570:         .headers()
571:         .get(header::IF_NONE_MATCH)
572:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
573:     if if_none_match != Some("*") {
574:         return (
575:             StatusCode::PRECONDITION_REQUIRED,
576:             "If-None-Match: * is required to create a resource",
577:         )
578:             .into_response();
579:     }
580: 
581:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(&calendar.role) else {
582:         return dav_server_error();
583:     };
584:     if authorize_calendar_action(
585:         UserStatus::Active,
586:         Some(PlatformRole::User),
587:         Some(role),
588:         CalendarAction::CreateEvent,
589:     ) != AuthorizationDecision::Allow
590:     {
591:         return dav_resource_not_found();
592:     }
593: 
594:     let body = match axum::body::to_bytes(request.into_body(), query::MAX_BODY_BYTES).await {
595:         Ok(body) => body,
596:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("request body too large"),
597:     };
598:     let body_str = match std::str::from_utf8(&body) {
599:         Ok(value) => value,
600:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("request body must be UTF-8"),
601:     };
602:     let parsed = match parse_calendar(body_str, IcsParserLimits::default()) {
603:         Ok(parsed) => parsed,
604:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("invalid calendar data"),
605:     };
606:     if parsed.events.len() != 1 {
607:         return dav_bad_request("exactly one VEVENT is required");
608:     }
609:     let incoming = &parsed.events[0];
610:     if incoming.rrule.is_some() || incoming.recurrence_id.is_some() {
611:         return dav_bad_request("recurring events are not supported");
612:     }
613:     let timing = match &incoming.timing {
614:         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::Timed {
615:             starts_at,
616:             ends_at,
617:             timezone,
618:         } => EventTiming::Timed {
619:             start_utc: starts_at.timestamp(),
620:             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
621:             timezone: timezone.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
622:         },
623:         _ => return dav_bad_request("only timed events are supported"),
624:     };
625:     if let EventTiming::Timed {
626:         start_utc, end_utc, ..
627:     } = &timing
628:         && start_utc >= end_utc
629:     {
630:         return dav_bad_request("event end must be after start");
631:     }
632:     let status = match incoming.status.as_deref() {
633:         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
634:         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
635:         _ => EventStatus::Confirmed,
636:     };
637:     if incoming.summary.trim().is_empty() {
638:         return dav_bad_request("SUMMARY is required");
639:     }
640: 
641:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
642:     if repository
643:         .resolve_by_name(calendar.calendar_id, resource_name)
644:         .await
645:         .ok()
646:         .flatten()
647:         .is_some()
648:     {
649:         return (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "resource already exists").into_response();
650:     }
651: 
652:     let mutation = EventMutation {
653:         title: incoming.summary.clone(),
654:         description: incoming.description.clone(),
655:         location: incoming.location.clone(),
656:         status,
657:         timing,
658:     };
659:     let event_service = EventService::new_at(accounts.pool().clone(), accounts.now());
660:     let projection = match event_service
661:         .create(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, mutation)
662:         .await
663:     {
664:         Ok(projection) => projection,
665:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
666:     };
667:     let event_id = projection.id;
668: 
669:     let now = accounts.now();
670:     let resource = match repository
671:         .create_resource(
672:             calendar.calendar_id,
673:             event_id,
674:             &incoming.uid,
675:             resource_name,
676:             now,
677:         )
678:         .await
679:     {
680:         Ok(resource) => resource,
681:         Err(error) => {
682:             let _ = event_service
683:                 .delete(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, event_id)
684:                 .await;
685:             return match error {
686:                 CaldavAuthError::ResourceExists => {
687:                     (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "resource already exists").into_response()
688:                 }
689:                 CaldavAuthError::UidConflict => {
690:                     (StatusCode::CONFLICT, "uid already exists in calendar").into_response()
691:                 }
692:                 _ => dav_server_error(),
693:             };
694:         }
695:     };
696: 
697:     let event_record = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
698:         .event(calendar.calendar_id, event_id)
699:         .await
700:     {
701:         Ok(Some(event_record)) => event_record,
702:         _ => return dav_server_error(),
703:     };
704:     let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event_record, DavReadAccess::Details) else {
705:         return dav_server_error();
706:     };
707:     let location = format!(
708:         "/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{}/{}.ics",
709:         calendar.calendar_id, resource.resource_name
710:     );
711:     (
712:         StatusCode::CREATED,
713:         [
714:             (header::LOCATION, location.as_str()),
715:             (header::ETAG, etag.as_str()),
716:             (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"),
717:         ],
718:         ical,
719:     )
720:         .into_response()
721: }

880: /// Conditional `DELETE` that removes one existing supported event through the
881: /// domain service and retains the DAV mapping as a durable tombstone.
882: ///
883: /// Requires `If-Match` carrying the current ETag. Fails with 412 when the
884: /// precondition is missing or stale, without mutating the event. On success the
885: /// event is deleted and the resource row is tombstoned (event reference
886: /// cleared, deletion stamped) so the mapping survives for other clients. If the
887: /// domain delete fails after the tombstone is written, the tombstone is
888: /// compensated back to the live mapping.
889: async fn handle_delete_event_resource(
890:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
891:     session: &DavSession,
892:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
893:     resource_name: &str,
894:     request: Request,
895: ) -> Response {
896:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(&calendar.role) else {
897:         return dav_server_error();
898:     };
899:     if authorize_calendar_action(
900:         UserStatus::Active,
901:         Some(PlatformRole::User),
902:         Some(role),
903:         CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent,
904:     ) != AuthorizationDecision::Allow
905:     {
906:         return dav_resource_not_found();
907:     }
908: 
909:     let if_match = request
910:         .headers()
911:         .get(header::IF_MATCH)
912:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
913:     let Some(if_match) = if_match else {
914:         return (
915:             StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED,
916:             "If-Match is required to delete a resource",
917:         )
918:             .into_response();
919:     };
920: 
921:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
922:     let resource = match repository
923:         .resolve_by_name(calendar.calendar_id, resource_name)
924:         .await
925:     {
926:         Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
927:         Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
928:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
929:     };
930:     if event_is_imported(accounts.pool(), resource.event_id).await {
931:         return dav_resource_not_found();
932:     }
933: 
934:     let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
935:         .event(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id)
936:         .await
937:     {
938:         Ok(Some(event)) => event,
939:         Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
940:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
941:     };
942:     let Some((_, current_etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event, DavReadAccess::Details) else {
943:         return dav_resource_not_found();
944:     };
945:     if !etag_matches(if_match, &current_etag) {
946:         return (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "precondition failed").into_response();
947:     }
948: 
949:     let now = accounts.now();
950:     let tombstoned = match repository
951:         .tombstone_resource(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id, now)
952:         .await
953:     {
954:         Ok(tombstoned) => tombstoned,
955:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
956:     };
957:     if !tombstoned {
958:         // The live mapping disappeared between the precondition check and the
959:         // tombstone write; treat as an already-deleted resource.
960:         return dav_resource_not_found();
961:     }
962: 
963:     let event_service = EventService::new_at(accounts.pool().clone(), accounts.now());
964:     let delete_result = event_service
965:         .delete(
966:             session.user_id,
967:             false,
968:             calendar.calendar_id,
969:             resource.event_id,
970:         )
971:         .await;
972:     if let Err(error) = delete_result {
973:         // Compensate the tombstone so the mapping is not left dangling.
974:         let _ = repository
975:             .restore_resource(
976:                 calendar.calendar_id,
977:                 resource.event_id,
978:                 resource_name,
979:                 accounts.now(),
980:             )
981:             .await;
982:         return match error {
983:             EventServiceError::NotFound => dav_resource_not_found(),
984:             EventServiceError::ReadOnly => dav_resource_not_found(),
985:             _ => dav_server_error(),
986:         };
987:     }
988: 
989:     StatusCode::NO_CONTENT.into_response()
990: }

992: /// True when an `If-Match` precondition is satisfied by the current ETag.

994: /// Accepts the wildcard and a comma-separated list of strong ETags, comparing
995: /// each against the current tag.

1000:     }
1001:     if_match
1002:         .split(',')
1003:         .map(|tag| tag.trim())
1004:         .any(|tag| tag == current_etag)
1005: }

1151: ///
1152: /// Each requested href yields exactly one `<D:response>`. Hrefs that do not
1153: /// resolve to an exposed resource in this collection — including foreign
1154: /// paths — return a per-item 404 so existence is never leaked.

1165:     let events = EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
1166:     let mut responses = Vec::with_capacity(multiget.hrefs.len());
1167:     for href in &multiget.hrefs {
1168:         let resource_name = match href_within_collection(href, principal_id, calendar.calendar_id) {
1169:             Some(name) => name,
1170:             None => {
1171:                 responses.push(multiget_response_xml(href, None));
1172:                 continue;
1173:             }
1174:         };
1175:         let resource = match repository
1176:             .resolve_by_name(calendar.calendar_id, &resource_name)
1177:             .await
1178:         {
1179:             Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
1180:             Ok(None) => {
1181:                 responses.push(multiget_response_xml(href, None));
1182:                 continue;
1183:             }

1197:              )",

1199:         .bind(resource.event_id)
1200:         .fetch_one(accounts.pool())
1201:         .await
1202:         .unwrap_or(false);

1204:             responses.push(multiget_response_xml(href, None));

1208:         responses.push(multiget_response_xml(href, payload));

1212:         r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
1213: <D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
1214: {body}
1215: </D:multistatus>"#
1216:     );
1217:     (
1218:         StatusCode::MULTI_STATUS,
1219:         [(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/xml; charset=utf-8")],
1220:         xml,
1221:     )
1222:         .into_response()

1386:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");

1390:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
